title: fix(plugin-detail): an authored record page folds its all-empty field groups into one closing line
body:
Fixes #35019
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXBffgVtUPBEY2nLFm

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自建记录页（如 HotCRM 商机页）的「明细」里，字段全空的分组不再各占一张带边框的卡，而是折进明细末尾的一行「商机叙述 · 备注与下一步 · 2 个空分区 · 展开」，与默认记录页同一个设计；点「展开」后两组回到原位，各自是一张卡（标题加一行「显示 N 个空字段」），从那一行可显示并就地编辑字段。
- 为什么改：新建商机时这两张空卡各占约 80px，看起来像有内容，其实什么都没有；默认记录页早已折成一行，自建页没有跟上。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `record:details` 明细体的只读展示；有内容的分组（含其「显示 N 个空字段」）、编辑态、打印页、独立的 `detail-view` 都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据或元数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`（决定哪些明细体画这一行的判断）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx`（`record:details` 打开该判断的包裹）、`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`（`hideEmpty` 的 describe 改写）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/EmptySectionsLine.authoredPage-35019.test.tsx`，预期 10 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On an authored record page, a `record:details` body drew every group the page keeps with `hideEmpty: false` as its own bordered card even when all its fields were empty: a card holding a heading and one "Show N empty fields" row. The synthesized default page already folds such groups into one closing line (`EmptySectionsLine`, objectstack#27055 Target 2), but `DetailView` drew that line only under `DefaultRecordPageContext`, so an authored page fell to the whole-body fold, which folds only when every group is empty. Scope as corrected on the card (comment 6970082809): draw the same line on authored `record:details` pages, no new design, no new metadata key.

- **The switch.** `RecordDetailsRenderer` now wraps the `DetailView` it mounts in a new module-internal `EmptySectionsLineContext` (in `defaultRecordPage.ts`, beside the other record-page face contexts; not re-exported from the barrel, not a prop, not a schema key, the `RecordPageProvenanceContext` precedent). `DetailView` draws `EmptySectionsLine` when that context or `useDefaultRecordPage()` is on and the body has no `sectionGroups`. Every other body keeps `EmptySectionsFold` unchanged.
- **Paths an authored `record:details` reaches, and which this covers.** `record:details` always hands `DetailView` a schema with `sections` (or the direct-`fields` fallback), never `autoTabs`, `tabs` or `sectionGroups`, so it always reaches the non-tab sections block, which is the branch this changes. The HotCRM opportunity page's `{ group }` references are resolved to `sections` with `fields` by the renderer, so they arrive as `sections`. Not changed: the `autoTabs` body and `sectionGroups` bodies (reached only by a `detail-view` node), and the direct-`fields` fallback (one section, no fold either way). A bound `record:details` (per-element `dataSource`) draws the line too; measured producers of a bound `record:details` in HotCRM and the showcase/CRM examples: 0.
- **The whole-body fold.** On a `record:details` body it is subsumed by the line: a body whose every kept group is empty now draws the line naming them all, where it drew one unnamed "Show N empty fields" row (pinned). Everywhere else it keeps working as before (CONTROL pin, and the objectui#13386 suite, unchanged and green).
- **Kept as is.** A group with a value draws as before, its own "Show N empty fields" row included. Edit mode and a print page draw every group. `hideEmpty` keeps its default, and a group the default hides is never named in the line.
- **Contract prose the change would make false, restated (ruling 6970082809; ruling C on objectui#13386 is kept as the expanded face).** The `describe()` of `RecordDetailsProps.sections[].hideEmpty` in `@objectstack/spec` said a kept all-empty section renders, read-only, as its heading plus one fold row. On `record:details`, its only renderer, it is now named in the closing line first. Restated there and in its mirrors: the `@object-ui/types` docs (`RecordDetailsProps` section, `DetailViewSection.hideEmpty`), the `record:details` `sections` input description in the component registry, the plugin README. Regenerated, not hand-edited: `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`), `sdui.manifest.json` with `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (`node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`), `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx` (`node scripts/gen-sdui-reference.mjs`).
- **Two stale pins, updated.** `record-details.emptySectionDefault.test.tsx` and `record-details.hideEmptyRetired-7129.test.tsx` each pinned a kept all-empty section drawing its heading first through `record:details`, the exact face this changes. Both now assert the line names it, expand the line, and then assert the same heading plus fold row as before.

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/EmptySectionsLine.authoredPage-35019.test.tsx`, 10 tests, through the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` with no `DefaultRecordPageContext` (the HotCRM opportunity's groups as the fixture):
  - two all-empty kept groups beside two filled ones: one line, count 2, naming both, after every drawn group; only the two filled groups draw a card;
  - the partly-filled group keeps its own "Show 5 empty fields" row, before and after expanding;
  - expanding draws all four groups in their authored order, each empty one as its heading plus its own fold row; collapsing folds them back;
  - revealing a group's empty fields and double-clicking one enters inline edit, and edit mode draws every group with inputs (no line);
  - every group empty: the line names them all and no whole-body row is drawn;
  - a group hidden by the `hideEmpty` default is not named;
  - a print page draws every group, no line;
  - CONTROL, a standalone `DetailView`: a card per empty group with its fold row, and the whole-body fold when all are empty.
- Ablation (one-off, on commit `61c05ae8`): `DetailView` mutated back to the old gate (`return onDefaultRecordPage && …` in place of `return emptySectionsAsLine && …`) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `03ed8fb5` to `2022a062`; the new file went **7 failed, 3 passed** (the 3 are the print-page case and the two CONTROL cases, which hold either way); restore proven by blob equal to HEAD `03ed8fb5` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No `dist/` is in the resolution path (the tests import the sources relatively), so no rebuild leg applies.
- Red set before the pin updates (on `a0d385a9`, the switch alone): plugin-detail 2 failed files, 383 passed; the two failures are the two pins named above.
- Final head `429ee81c`, results under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **The default page draws this line only for groups a page keeps.** The synthesized default page writes `{ group }` sections with no `hideEmpty`, so `record:details` resolves them to `true` and an all-empty group is hidden outright there; the line has nothing to fold on a synthesized page. It draws where a page keeps a group with `hideEmpty: false`, as the HotCRM opportunity page does. Unchanged by this PR; an observation.
- **After expanding, the fields are one more click away**: each empty group draws its heading plus its own "Show N empty fields" row (ruling C on objectui#13386), which is the shipped default-page design ("no new design"). The card's acceptance item "展开后能看到全部空字段，并能就地编辑" holds through that row, and the reader's show-empty choice is per object where the host stores it.
- **Beyond the claim's file surface** (DetailView.tsx, EmptySectionsFold.tsx, new tests, `.changeset/`): `renderers/record-details.tsx` (the context provider), `defaultRecordPage.ts` (the context, beside its siblings), the two stale pins, and the contract prose and generated mirrors listed above, which the change would otherwise have left false.
- A code comment in app-shell's `RecordDetailView` still lists "the empty-sections line" among the faces only the synthesized page draws; not edited here (another package, comment only). `recordPageV3Face-27055.test.tsx`'s CONTROL is named "outside the default page no line draws"; it renders a bare `DetailView`, which still draws none, so it stays green.
- Not browser-verified; the pins drive the real `record:details` renderer.
